research_question: Can prior-only bipower-variation jump detection separate systemic information co-jumps from idiosyncratic leverage jumps before entry, and do the resulting state transitions retain after-cost expectancy across a year-long stability period and the latest daily archives?

scenario.event_detector: a five-minute return is a jump only when its absolute log return exceeds four prior-only continuous-volatility sigmas estimated from rolling bipower variation and futures quote volume is abnormal

state_router.SYSTEMIC_COJUMP_ACCEPTANCE: futures, spot and composite index jump in the same direction, at least half of peer spot markets agree, base OI does not collapse and futures aggressor flow is aligned
state_router.IDIOSYNCRATIC_LEVERAGE_JUMP_RECLAIM: the perpetual future jumps without matching spot/index delivery, the futures-spot return gap is abnormal and base OI collapses
state_router.UNRESOLVED: ordinary large returns, unconfirmed co-jumps and ambiguous leverage shocks are no-trade

independent_confirmation.SYSTEMIC_COJUMP_ACCEPTANCE: the next completed five-minute bar extends, OI does not unwind, futures flow remains aligned and spot/index/peer breadth continue in the jump direction; trade continuation after that close
independent_confirmation.IDIOSYNCRATIC_LEVERAGE_JUMP_RECLAIM: the next completed bar fails, OI contraction stops, futures flow flips and spot still does not follow; trade reversal after that close

scenario.exit: fixed two-hour continuation or one-hour reclaim horizon, both belonging to the post-confirmation intraday leg
scenario.causal_episode: one co-jump timestamp shared across all four markets; same-symbol events are suppressed for the active route horizon

data.spot_source: Binance Vision monthly and latest daily spot 5m klines
data.futures_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and latest daily futures 5m klines and indexPriceKlines
data.state_source: Binance Vision USD-M daily 5m metrics using base sum_open_interest
data.visibility: jump statistics use only observations completed before the event; state confirmation uses the separately completed next bar

evaluation.same_event_arbitration: largest fixed jump-context-times-state-quality score, then symbol
evaluation.overlap_policy: no selected episode while the chosen fixed route horizon is active

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day after global arbitration

decision_contract.advance: A fixed family passing development, year-long stability, July confirmation and the predeclared August pulse may be frozen for NautilusTrader; it is not a final system unless integrated frequency and continuous NAV also pass.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune jump or state thresholds after evaluation. Preserve only a route positive across every declared split and move to another independent mechanism.
